recipes.name: Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice
Pinch of salt and white pepper ((sub black))
instructions: Mix the ingredients together, starting with 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice, then adding the other if you want it a bit tangier. Ready to use!
